correctness.rationale: PASS. For n>=3 the directed arcs of complete loopless K_n form a closed-hemisphere (big constellation) nerve exactly when the graph is not strongly connected. The root (e_j-e_i)/sqrt2, cone lineality W_I, and order-reversed type-A flat lattice make Construction 2.9's map S_n-equivariant. For any H-fixed DAG face its lower fiber has the fixed top element. For an H-invariant proper nonzero flat Pi the lower fiber is the nerve of the closed convex sets B_i: inequalities <u,z_i>>=0 on roots in Pi and >=1 otherwise. This family is permuted by H; every H-stable nonempty intersection admits a fixed witness by averaging. Nerve of orbit intersections in V_n^H equals the geometric fixed face nerve. The orbit sets cover V_n^H because a nonzero arrangement flat contains an antipodal root pair with complementary >=0 halfspaces. Convex intersections are contractible, so every fixed lower fiber is contractible; fixed-poset Quillen plus equivariant Whitehead gives genuine equivalence, not homeomorphism. DAG open hemispheres likewise have fixed nonzero averaged witnesses and equivariantly nerve-model S(V_n). For transitive H, V_n^H=0; regular H-invariant partitions are exactly coset equivalence relations from proper nontrivial subgroups. The squarefree cyclic/elementary abelian corollaries use standard divisor-lattice and Solomon-Tits results, not an invented topological classification. Independently enumerated direct transitive closure for all 1,020 step-subsets under cyclic regular actions n=3..10, matching the gcd=1 criterion. This finite check corroborates only finite cases; the proof handles all groups n>=3.
